India maintains travel advisories for Iran and Kailash Mansarovar

India has issued advisories recommending citizens avoid non-essential travel to Iran, citing rapidly changing regional circumstances despite some security improvements. Separately, India has also cautioned against undertaking the Kailash Mansarovar yatra without proper Chinese visas and permits, with reports of pilgrims being stranded. These advisories highlight ongoing concerns for Indian nationals undertaking international travel.
